sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 355)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and syndication, Joan Fontaine & John Loder starring in Jane Austen's *Pride and Prejudice* on *Theater of Romance* for Colgate (1944), Sammy Kaye's swing showroom for Chrysler (1943), Conrad Nagel hosting *The Man-God of Japan* on *Radio Reader's Digest* for Campbell's Soup (1943), Arlene Francis in *Betty and Bob*, Edward Eggleston's *The Hoosier Schoolmaster*, and CBS wartime news (1940–1947):
